title: 第9章 跌落神坛第10章 好久不见
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
六年后，乌泽城的街道上。
一个头发乱糟糟的少年精神恍惚地走着，口中喃喃自语：“你去哪里了？出来啊！”
路上的行人纷纷看向他，窃窃私语着投来不同的目光，有人同情，有人讥讽，还有人憎恶……
“这人是谁啊？”
“他你都不认识？他就是陆家少爷陆沉！”
“陆沉？就是那个天赐九脉的天才？”
“天才？已经是过去式了！
他现在如你所见只是一个开蒙一重的废人罢了。”
“怎么会这样？我听说他开蒙当场就达到开蒙九重了，还以为咱们乌泽城要出个了不起的大人物呢。”
“谁知道呢！
据说开蒙当天晚上的家宴他被人当场废了，从此以后就疯疯癫癫的了。”
“陆家对我们多好啊，这是做的什么孽啊……”
听着人们窃窃私语的议论声，陆沉的思绪不由得回到了六年前，自己开蒙那天的陆家家宴上：
那天陆府张灯结彩，陆家上下欢聚一堂，就连已经隐退的陆沉的爷爷陆丰都出现了，所有人都沉浸在喜悦的氛围中，就连一向排挤陆沉的二叔和陆升也换上了一副喜悦的表情，纵使他们再羡慕嫉妒陆沉，但他们心里明白，不出意外的话陆沉会是为绝代天骄，明眼人都能看出来，以后陆家绝对是以陆沉为重中之重的，而以陆沉的天赋看来，只要他能正常成长起来，那绝对能把陆家带上一个前所未有的高度。
然而就在所有人都欢颜笑语时，一个不速之客出现在众人面前，那是一个美艳到不可方物的女人，漆黑的斗篷下是一位倾国倾城的冰山美人。
陆沉仍旧记得她那冷艳的气质和俯瞰一切的姿态，在她眼里，仿佛眼前的其他人如同蝼蚁一般，而她身上散发出的气势让人望而生畏，在场的所有人都安静了下来。
看着神秘女人散发出的强大气势，陆凯之作为家主连忙起身上前行礼：“不知前辈大驾光临，有失远迎，还望前辈见谅。
敢问前辈名讳？”
那女人也不回答，只是直直地看着陆沉，那目光让人不寒而栗。
9527想要扫描眼前的女人，结果屏幕上出现一个大大的红色感叹号！

苟系统瞬间慌了，心里默念道：“按我的经验来看，这种时候出现这种未知强者，大概率是仇家之类的，难道要出现主角的家人的家人集体祭天这种事？”
“苟宿主，小心点，随时准备逃，恐怕来者不善。”
9527开口提醒道。
“这有什么，一个女人而已，有什么好怕的。”
陆沉经过今天的天赐九脉，此刻有些膨胀了，完全不觉得自己面前的女人会给自己带来危险。
“你，跟我走！”
那女人伸手指向陆沉，冰冷的声音如同高高在上的女帝一般。
“前辈，初次见面就要带走我儿子，未免有些太过分了吧！”
陆凯之霸气地挡在那女人面前，三境二重的气势猛然展露出来，陆家其他长辈见状也是纷纷站起来露出气势。
然而，一股巨大的寒气瞬间席卷了整个陆家：“废话太多了。”
陆丰连忙喊道：“小辈都走！”
众人闻言这才从震惊中反应过来。
陆家的所有人都开始行动起来，有实力的大人挡在那女人面前。
孩子们在大人的催促下开始从后门逃走。
陆沉见状还想留下：“爷爷，我不走，我有元力，我要留下和你们并肩作战！”
陆丰怒视着这个头铁的孙子，大喊道：“她的目标就是你！
以你现在的实力什么都做不了，你快走，不要辜负了我们！”
“我不！”
陆沉倔强地回答。
“小升，快带他走！”

陆丰怒吼着。
陆升闻言也是急忙拉起陆沉就走，陆升虽然天赋不如陆沉，但毕竟年长三岁，早已达到一境二重的实力，力气也比陆沉大不少。
陆沉挣扎着被陆升拉出陆家：“放开我，我要回去！”
content_en:
Six years later, on the streets of Wuze City.
A young man with messy hair was walking in a daze, muttering to himself: "Where have you been? Come out!"
Pedestrians on the road looked at him one after another, whispering and casting different looks. Some sympathized, some ridiculed, and some hated...
"Who is this person?"
"You don't even know him? He is the young master of the Lu family, Lu Chen!"
"Lu Chen? Is he the genius who was gifted with nine meridians?"
"Genius? It's a thing of the past!
As you can see, he is just a useless person with the first level of enlightenment. "
"How could this happen? I heard that he reached the ninth level of enlightenment on the spot. I thought we were going to have a great big shot in Wuze City."
"Who knows!
It is said that he was destroyed on the spot at the family dinner on the night of Kaimeng, and he has been crazy since then. "
"The Lu family is so kind to us. What kind of evil are they doing..."
Listening to people's whispers, Lu Chen's thoughts couldn't help but go back to the Lu family banquet on the day he was born six years ago:
That day, the Lu Mansion was decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations, and the Lu family gathered together happily. Even Lu Chen's grandfather Lu Feng, who had retired, appeared. Everyone was immersed in the atmosphere of joy. Even the second uncle and Lu Sheng, who had always ostracized Lu Chen, also had happy expressions. Even if they were envious and jealous of Lu Chen, But they knew in their hearts that if nothing unexpected happened, Lu Chen would be an unparalleled talent. Anyone with a discerning eye could see that the Lu family would definitely give Lu Chen the top priority in the future. And judging from Lu Chen's talent, as long as he could grow up normally, he would definitely be able to bring the Lu family to an unprecedented height.
However, just when everyone was laughing and talking, an uninvited guest appeared in front of everyone. It was an extremely beautiful woman. Under the dark cloak was an iceberg beauty who would conquer the entire country.
Lu Chen still remembered her cold temperament and her attitude of overlooking everything. In her eyes, it was as if the other people in front of her were like ants, and the aura she exuded was intimidating, and everyone present fell silent.
Seeing the powerful aura exuded by the mysterious woman, Lu Kaizhi, as the head of the family, quickly stood up and saluted: "I don't know that senior has come to visit me. I am sorry that I am not welcoming you from afar. I hope you will forgive me."
Dare you ask your senior’s name? "
The woman didn't answer, but looked straight at Lu Chen, her gaze making people shudder.
9527 wanted to scan the woman in front of him, but a big red exclamation mark appeared on the screen!
System Gou panicked for a moment and thought to himself: "According to my experience, if such an unknown strong person appears at this time, it is most likely an enemy. Is it possible that the protagonist's family members will collectively sacrifice to heaven?"
"Host Gou, be careful and be ready to escape at any time, I'm afraid the one who comes is not good."
9527 reminded.
"What's there? It's just a woman. There's nothing to be afraid of."
Lu Chen had experienced today's nine divine meridians and was a little swollen at the moment. He didn't feel that the woman in front of him would bring any danger to him.
"You, come with me!"
The woman pointed at Lu Chen and spoke in a cold voice like a condescending empress.
"Senior, it would be too much to take away my son when we first met!"
Lu Kaizhi stood in front of the woman domineeringly, and his aura of the second level of the third realm suddenly appeared. Seeing this, the other elders of the Lu family also stood up and showed their aura.
However, a huge chill instantly swept through the entire Lu family: "Too much nonsense."
Lu Feng quickly shouted: "Everyone, juniors, leave!"
After hearing this, everyone reacted from the shock.
Everyone in the Lu family started to take action, and the powerful adults stood in front of the woman.
The children began to escape out the back door at the urging of the adults.
When Lu Chen saw this, he wanted to stay: "Grandpa, I won't leave. I have Yuan Power. I want to stay and fight alongside you!"
Lu Feng glared at thisThe stubborn grandson shouted: "Her target is you!
You can't do anything with your current strength, so hurry up and don't let us down! "
"I don't!"
Lu Chen replied stubbornly.
"Xiao Sheng, take him away quickly!"
Lu Feng roared.
When Lu Sheng heard this, he hurriedly pulled Lu Chen up and left. Although Lu Sheng was not as talented as Lu Chen, he was three years older and had already reached the first level and second level, and was much stronger than Lu Chen.
Lu Chen struggled and was pulled out of the Lu family by Lu Sheng: "Let me go, I want to go back!"
